summary: Composed the offline runtime: docker-compose services for the app, PostgreSQL (authoritative DB via DATABASE_URL), Valkey (disposable cache/broker), an S3-compatible object store (RustFS default, SeaweedFS compat profile) fronted by Caddy; env-driven settings.py (ALLOWED_HOSTS, DATABASE_URL, VALKEY_URL, S3_*, STATIC_ROOT/URL) with SQLite retained as the default for non-Compose local checks; added .dockerignore, .env.example, infra/Caddyfile, infra/api.Dockerfile.

uv run --frozen ruff check src/api tests
